summary: AB Private Lending Fund, a Delaware closed-end fund, filed an 8-K reporting a small unregistered sale of 2,057 Class I common shares for $50,694.80 under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S, plus a monthly distribution declaration and NAV update. Class I NAV was $24.64 as of Aug 31, 2026; aggregate NAV was about $164.4 million against $376.2 million portfolio fair value and $213.8 million debt. It is conducting a continuous public offering up to $1.0 billion, with $170.1 million total consideration raised. This is routine fund reporting, not a special situation.
